points.description: Identifies the convolutional layer, which uses kernels (filters) that convolve over the input image. Equivalent wording (e.g. 'filters sliding over the image') earns the mark.

Describes the rest of the structure as further layers: an activation layer (e.g. ReLU), a pooling layer (max or average), and one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax layer. Naming the layers is enough; the order need not be explained in detail.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.5 for naming some but not all of the activation, pooling, fully connected and softmax layers.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) require the convolutional layer with kernels convolving over the input image, plus the later layers (activation, pooling, fully connected with softmax). Naming only some of the later layers earns half of the second mark. Any answer that does not describe the convolutional layer or lists only generic terms such as "layers" earns no marks for that point.
